name: Supplier quote normalization
problem_statement: Procurement teams spend time manually comparing supplier quotes whose scope, tax basis, currency, delivery, and payment terms differ.
target_buyer: Small and midsize procurement or operations teams handling recurring supplier quotes
next_test: Offer a free sample comparison and measure attributable external purchase completion; do not treat page views or unpaid checkouts as validation.

name: Agentic commerce remediation blueprint
problem_statement: A merchant needs a bounded, evidence-led review of one AI-assisted commerce journey and a prioritized remediation plan.
target_buyer: E-commerce or platform owner evaluating agent-driven discovery, authorization, checkout, and fulfilment
next_test: Improve inbound discovery and use the existing fixed-scope offer. Verify buyer attribution, settlement, delivery, and acceptance before promoting.

name: Truth Oracle claim checker
problem_statement: A user needs a quick, source-linked way to inspect a claim and distinguish supported, contradicted, stale, and unknown statements.
target_buyer: Operators and teams who need evidence checks before publishing or acting
next_test: Keep as a queue candidate only; low buyer and willingness-to-pay H-scores block build work until a sharper paid use case is identified.
